You will compare one known error in a data agent's work against a ranked list of items produced by a reviewer. Your job is to decide whether any item in the list identifies this known error, and if so, which one.

An item identifies the known error only if both of these hold:
- It is about the same thing: the same table, and the same column, computation, filter, or join.
- It points to the same problem: what the item says is wrong, assumed, or missing is the same as what went wrong in the known error. It does not matter whether the item is phrased as an assumption the agent made ("the agent assumes ...") or as a problem in the work ("this does not match ..."); judge by meaning.

An item does not count if it only says that something may be wrong without saying what, such as "this column may be computed incorrectly". An item about the same column but a different problem does not count.

If more than one item identifies the error, report the highest-ranked one. If you are unsure, say so rather than guessing.

Return a JSON object with:
- "verdict": "match", "no_match", or "unsure".
- "rank": the position of the matching item (1 is the top), or null.
- "quote": the exact words from the matching item that show it identifies the error, or null.
- "reason": one short sentence.

=== Known error ===
Table: stg_pendo__user
What the agent's work assumed: user_type 不用先转小写、去空格，就能直接做取值校验
What was actually required or true: 先转小写、去空格，再校验

=== Reviewer's ranked list for this table ===
[
  {
    "rank": 1,
    "item": {
      "statement": "Every retained source row already yields non-null values for all contract-required columns that the generated SQL does not explicitly filter.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "staging.stg_pendo__user, staging.stg_pendo__account_history, staging.stg_pendo__visitor_history, staging.stg_pendo__feature_event, staging.stg_pendo__guide_event, staging.stg_pendo__visitor_account_history, staging.stg_pendo__poll, staging.stg_pendo__page_history, staging.stg_pendo__guide_history, staging.stg_pendo__group, staging.stg_pendo__poll_event, staging.stg_pendo__guide_step_history, staging.stg_pendo__feature_history, staging.stg_pendo__page_event, staging.stg_pendo__page_rule_history",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "wh=[]; only t.get('where_conditions',[]) and the user/event special cases populate filters; conversions otherwise use TRY_CAST without checking their results.",
      "alternative": "These tables declare \"constraints: [not_null]\" for required identifiers and, in several event tables, occurred_at; the contract describes deleting rows with \"Invalid primary keys\".",
      "reason": "Missing source values or failed conversions can leave unusable records in many downstream models.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c2-2",
      "call": 2
    }
  },
  {
    "rank": 2,
    "item": {
      "statement": "Checking the allowed user types before lowercasing and trimming produces the required retained user population.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "staging.stg_pendo__user",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "The SELECT uses 'LOWER(TRIM(user_type))', while wh includes \"user_type IN ('system','internal','api','external')\".",
      "alternative": "The contract requires \"user_type = LOWER(TRIM(user_type))\" with \"on_failure: correct\", supporting normalization before rejecting values outside the allowed set.",
      "reason": "Correctable uppercase or padded user types would be deleted instead of standardized.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c2-6",
      "call": 2
    }
  },
  {
    "rank": 3,
    "item": {
      "statement": "Directly casting nonempty user deleted_at strings is equivalent to the contract's local-time string-truncation procedure.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "staging.stg_pendo__user.deleted_at",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'deleted_at':\"TRY_CAST(NULLIF(deleted_at, '') AS TIMESTAMP)\"",
      "alternative": "The implementation notes prescribe truncating timestamp strings to their first 23 characters before conversion.",
      "reason": "Any parsing difference affects deletion timestamps, though this field is optional.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c2-8",
      "call": 2
    }
  }
]
